_doc: Fired from code (RecreationUtility.Announce), no trigger. An activity announces itself - a solo booking when it is booked / moved / cancelled, a session once it resolves (confirmed or cancelled, after its invitees answered in the hour's late passes) and when it is cancelled later. Self = the first participant who is the player or visible to the player; $activityText$ = the header, the activity line (activity @ venue, time, cancel reason) and the participants, already built and localized by code. Forced on screen inside an event Result with displayOverride, in the midnight planning of the player's household, and for a session resolved at midnight with a household participant. See Docs/Activities/Plan_ActivityAnnouncements.md.
